instruct: A warm alto woman's voice, low-pitched and smooth, poised and confident; a smile audible under the calm; delight rises in the phrasing, not the pitch; crisp articulate diction, rich warm timbre.

text: Oh! Oh, you have to see this — I found it on the third shelf, exactly where it wanted to be. Take it, it's yours to borrow — just remember to bring it back!
